empty.mineText: A memo, application, report or letter is created with the “Create document” button. Drafts are kept here.
empty.allTitle: The register is empty so far
empty.allText: Letters, quotes and employee documents appear here as soon as they are registered.
empty.filteredText: Change the type or status — or create a new document.

list.caption: Documents: number, subject, type, status, amount and deadline

loadError.title: Could not load documents
loadError.text: The server did not respond. Check the connection and try again.

unavailable.title: Documents are unavailable
unavailable.text: The documents service is not responding. Try again later.

forbidden.title: Documents are not open to you

panel.label: Document
panel.routePreview: The route opens after sending: you → approval{{accountant}}.

loadError.title: Could not open the document
loadError.text: The server did not respond. Try again later.

notFound.title: Document not found
notFound.text: It does not exist or is not visible to you.

forbidden.title: The document is not open to you
forbidden.text: It is not granted to your role.

letter.title: Letter on letterhead
letter.noMailings: Not sent to the addressee yet.
letter.noSigner: Nobody can sign — an administrator grants the authority
letter.signModalDesc: The letter will receive an outgoing number and be officially registered with the signing basis recorded.
letter.sendImmediately: Send to the addressee's email immediately after signing
letter.noEmailWarning: Addressee email is not provided — the letter will not be sent by email.
letter.unmatched: The addressee is typed as text. Click “Continue” and pick the organization from counterparties — until then the letter can’t be signed.
letter.youSign: You are signing. Awaiting signature since {{date}}

refusal.author_cannot_sign: You are the author of this letter. The company rule is on: the author does not sign their own letter. {{name}} can sign it.

letter.withdrawn: The letter is withdrawn from signing

undelivered.title: The letter did not reach the addressee
undelivered.notTried: The letter is signed but has not been sent to the addressee yet.
undelivered.inProgress: The letter is being sent — the result will appear here.
undelivered.byRegistrar: The records clerk can send it again.

form.subtitle: The document goes for approval. You can save a draft and continue later in “Documents”.
form.subtitleContinue: Draft {{number}}: changes are saved, you can send it at any time.
form.subtitleReturned: {{number}} was returned for rework: fix it and send again.

type.label: Document type
type.locked: The type cannot be changed after creation.
type.letterHandover: You prepare the letter; an authorised signer signs it. The number and sending come after signing.

subject.label: Subject
subject.hint: Short, like a heading: up to 300 characters.

recipient.label: Addressee (organization)
recipient.pickHint: Pick a counterparty or add an organization from the last suggestion.

files.label: Attachments
files.hint: PDF, images and Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, each up to 25 MB.
files.tooLarge: The file is larger than 25 MB.
files.unsupported: PDF, images and Word, Excel and PowerPoint files are accepted.
files.invoiceLater: The partner's invoice will come later

deal.label: Link to a project
deal.hint: Optional: find a request or project by number, title or company.
deal.unavailable: Requests are unavailable right now — you can add the link later.

route.label: Approval route
route.letterHandover: You → signer: they sign, the letter gets its number and goes to the addressee
route.approversHint: Approve before the route steps, in the order chosen.
route.watchersHint: See the document but do not decide.

submit.uploadWait: Wait for the files to upload

validation.subject: Enter a subject.
validation.amount: The amount must be greater than zero, for example 1,500,000.
validation.due: “Needed by” cannot be in the past.
validation.recipient: Pick the organization from the list or add a new one.
validation.deal: Project not found — pick another or remove the link.
validation.replyTo: No incoming letter with this number. Check the number.
validation.recipientEmail: Check the addressee email, for example office@example.uz.
validation.signer: Choose a signer from the list: the selected one has no signing right.
validation.uploading: Wait for the files to upload.
validation.invoice: Attach the partner's invoice or tick that it will come later.

error.savedNote: The draft is saved and what you typed is kept. Fix it and send again.

reasons.FORBIDDEN: this action is not granted to your role
reasons.eds_not_granted: you have no rights in the documents service
reasons.not_author: only the author can edit the document
reasons.CONFLICT: the document has changed, refresh the page
reasons.invalid_state: the document is already sent or closed, refresh the page
reasons.BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE: the documents service is not responding, try again later
reasons.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: the file is larger than 25 MB
reasons.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: PDF, images and Word, Excel and PowerPoint files are accepted
reasons.REQUEST_TIMEOUT: the server did not respond in time
reasons.DEFAULT: the server returned an error, try again
reasons.letterhead_missing: the company letterhead is not set — an administrator saves “Settings · Details & letterhead”
reasons.no_body: the letter has no letterhead text
reasons.pdf_not_ready: the PDF is still being prepared
reasons.mail_in_progress: sending is in progress, wait for the result
reasons.no_authority: nobody has been given signing authority
reasons.signature_required: a letter gets its number only when signed — hand it over for signing
reasons.no_signing_authority: the signer has no valid signing authority
reasons.author_cannot_sign: the author does not sign their own letter
reasons.authority_mismatch: the authority does not cover this document
reasons.not_started: the authority is not in force yet
reasons.limit_exceeded: the amount is above the authority limit
reasons.currency_mismatch: the currency is not covered by the authority
reasons.holder_inactive: the authority holder no longer works at the company
reasons.deputy_without_authority: the deputy has no signing authority
reasons.deputy_loop: the substitution loops back to itself
reasons.no_permission: you have no right to sign
reasons.remind_too_soon: a reminder was already sent, you can repeat it in an hour
reasons.not_handed_over: the letter is not handed over for signing

draftLoadError.title: Could not open the draft
draftLoadError.text: It does not exist, is not visible to you, or the server did not respond.

notEditable.title: This document cannot be edited
notEditable.text: A draft and a document returned for rework can be edited. A sent document is waiting for a decision.

replyTo.label: In reply to incoming
replyTo.hint: Incoming number, e.g. IN-112/26: signing the letter closes the "Prepare a reply" instruction.

attention.label: Addressee line
attention.hint: Filled in by picking a person; you can edit it

email.label: Addressee email
email.hint: Optional. With an email, the letter goes to the addressee with the letterhead PDF right after signing.
email.notConnected: Document mail is not connected: the letter will be signed but will not reach the addressee. Tell the administrator.

body.label: Text
body.hint: Paragraphs, lists and tables. The company letterhead adds the requisites, number, date and signature.

signatory.name: Signatory
signatory.positionHint: From the directory; type your own for acting roles

letterhead.missing: The company letterhead is not set — the letter PDF cannot be built. An administrator saves “Settings · Details & letterhead”.

form.replyPrefilled: Filled in from {{number}}: check the correspondent, email and subject.

handover.from: Handing over letter {{number}}: the task closes once the memo is sent
handover.failed: Memo sent, but the task is not closed: {{reason}}

assist.briefHint: For example: ask to confirm the delivery date under the contract
assist.replaces: The text in the editor will be replaced — you can edit it afterwards
assist.failed: The helper did not answer — write the text yourself

person.label: To — person
person.hint: Optional. Picking fills in the email and the addressee line.

form.draftHint: A draft can be saved once there is a subject and text.

preview.title: Letterhead PDF
preview.hint: The server builds the PDF on the company letterhead — the addressee gets the same file.
preview.empty: Press “Show PDF”: the letter is saved as a draft and appears on the letterhead.
preview.readyFinal: PDF with the outgoing number ready · {{pages}} p.
preview.failedNoReason: Error: the PDF was not built
preview.name: Letter “{{subject}}”
preview.loadFailed: Could not load the PDF. Retry.
preview.emptyAuto: Fill in the subject, addressee and text — the letter is saved as a draft and appears on the letterhead.
